hyperedges.label: Session Management System
hyperedges.description: Integrated session lifecycle: API calls initiate sessions, WebSocket receives real-time updates, component displays and controls state

hyperedges.label: Metrics Collection Pipeline
hyperedges.description: Real-time metrics flow from WebSocket → hook → component visualization with standardized data structure

hyperedges.label: Authentication System
hyperedges.description: OAuth flow: GitHub callback → API exchange → token storage → auth state → page access control

hyperedges.label: Desktop Environment
hyperedges.description: Windowed desktop system: taskbar triggers window creation, store manages window state, workspace window renders content

hyperedges.label: Workspace Context System
hyperedges.description: Workspace-scoped operations: workspace store → API operations → session management → component rendering

hyperedges.name: Connected Session Lifecycle
hyperedges.description: Auth → WebSocket → Session forms a coordinated lifecycle for authenticated, real-time workspace sessions
hyperedges.explanation: User authenticates (auth_store), establishes WebSocket connection (websocket_store with auth token), then manages workspace sessions (session_store)

hyperedges.name: State Management Trio
hyperedges.description: Three Zustand stores coordinate user identity, connectivity, and resource management
hyperedges.explanation: All three use Zustand for consistent state patterns and collectively manage the frontend application state

hyperedges.label: Real-Time Streaming Architecture
hyperedges.description: WebSocket manager broadcasts metrics from session manager to frontend clients via standardized events

hyperedges.label: Authentication & Authorization Flow
hyperedges.description: OAuth2 code flow generates JWT and refresh tokens, validated via RBAC on all protected resources

hyperedges.label: GPU Allocation Pipeline
hyperedges.description: Scheduler queries all providers, scores candidates, allocates GPU, session manager executes on provider

hyperedges.label: Session Persistence & Failover
hyperedges.description: Auto-checkpoints every 5 min to storage, enables transparent failover if provider fails

hyperedges.label: Distributed Workflow Execution
hyperedges.description: Workflow nodes execute as Celery tasks on allocated sessions, progress streamed via WebSocket, outputs stored

hyperedges.label: Hot-Pluggable Provider Architecture
hyperedges.description: All providers implement ProviderBase interface for authentication, inventory, and session lifecycle

hyperedges.label: Backend Infrastructure Stack
hyperedges.description: FastAPI API with SQLAlchemy ORM, Celery task queue on Redis broker, PostgreSQL database, all containerized
